segments.contextAfter: In the Medications view, add Acetaminophen 500 mg Oral Capsule, Carbinoxamine Maleate Biphasic Release Oral Capsule (10 mg), or Ciprofloxacin Injection 200 mg/20 mL as a sample medication. The sample app associates symptoms with these three medications using their RxNorm codes by mapping the codes to their symptoms in the `SideEffects` dictionary in `SideEffects.swift`.
